result.planSummary: Extended archive reads with read-time artifact/source provenance enrichment, preserved canonical rows by layering enrichment only in the archive read service, surfaced the new provenance in the archive UI, and added Story 6 API/client coverage for happy-path and degraded lookup behavior.

changedFiles.reason: Extended the archive entry contract with optional artifact-version and source-provenance enrichment payloads.
Added read-time provenance enrichment, producing-process lookup, and per-entry degradation when related artifact/source context cannot be resolved.
Rendered related artifact-version, producing-process, and source provenance details on archive entries when present.
Added enriched archive-entry fixtures for artifact and source provenance scenarios.
Added Story 6 server coverage for artifact/source provenance visibility and per-entry degradation while seeding the in-memory store with related provenance data.
Added client coverage proving enriched archive provenance renders in the archive section.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec biome check --formatter-enabled=true --linter-enabled=true --assist-enabled=false apps/platform/shared/contracts/archive.ts apps/platform/server/services/archive/archive-read.service.ts apps/platform/client/features/processes/archive-section.ts tests/fixtures/archive.ts tests/service/server/archive-api.test.ts tests/service/client/archive-section.test.ts && corepack pnpm vitest tests/service/server/archive-api.test.ts tests/service/client/archive-section.test.ts

findingsFixed: Archive reads now enrich related artifact versions with producing-process provenance without mutating canonical archive storage.
Archive entries now degrade only the affected row when related source or artifact provenance cannot be resolved at read time.
Archive UI and tests now prove enriched provenance remains visible on the existing Story 3 surface.

result.recommendedNextStep: Proceed to story verification focused on Story 6 acceptance criteria and archive provenance regression review.
